facts.text: Resumebooster.ai is an automatic resume creator that converts a user's existing resume into an optimized scrummaster resume.
Resumebooster.ai is intended to be a lead generator for students to sign up for a certified scrummaster class.
The user wants a 12-step email nurture campaign for ResumeBooster users who do not already have their certified scrummaster certification.
The goal of the 12-email campaign is to have users sign up for a live online certified scrummaster class.
The live online certified scrummaster classes are offered on weekdays and weekends.
The classes are offered in 2 full-day options.
The classes are offered in 3 half-day options.
The user asked to include 3 additional emails at the beginning providing advice and motivation on switching careers to becoming a scrummaster.
The user asked to make the emails funnier.
The user asked to include a preview for each email with a length of 35-90 characters.
The user asked to reorder the emails to maximize customer conversion.
